session_summary: Session 5: shipped two big NEW surfaces beside the judge (judge UI deliberately untouched) + a per-user contest tracker, plus infra fixes. Ran a 106-agent grok research fan-out (grok beat agy 10/10 vs 7/10 on deep-research-with-link-verification) to author a curated CP sheet (43 topics, 1513 problems, importance-weighted 335 must-do CORE -> ~4-5 months at 2-3/day toward Candidate Master; post-Striver, Codeforces-style, LeetCode filtered out) and a System Design sheet (63 HLD/LLD modules: resources + questions + a repeatable framework, rendered as an explicitly SEQUENTIAL grouped/numbered checklist). Built the Contest Tracker: each user links CF/AtCoder/LeetCode/CodeChef handles once, and it auto-builds a rating trajectory vs a target line (CM/1900 by 2027-05-31), an on-track/behind/ahead verdict, contest cadence, a MULTI-SITE upcoming-contest feed (all four judges keyless), .ics reminders, and a deterministic 'Recommended for you' (every CF round always qualifies + level-matched others). Fully deterministic (no AI coach), per-user, $0. Added Ctrl/Cmd+' as a LeetCode-style submit shortcut. Canonicalized sidebar company names (de shaw + DE Shaw -> DE Shaw) and routed unknown/blank companies to a single 'Practice' company. Authored + gated a new problem practice-min-edge-reversals (0-1 BFS) under Iris-Personal/Practice (100% mutation; reference cross-checked vs Dijkstra brute over 500 random graphs). Fixed a real infra bug: the live volume bank was NOT a git checkout, so Sync (git ff-only) failed and prior bank pushes (batch8, DE Shaw) never reached the live app -- re-cloned the public oa-problems onto /data/problems as a proper checkout and restarted; live bank now 123.

decisions_made.decision: The CP sheet and the Contest Tracker are DISTINCT surfaces: the sheet is the curriculum (topics -> laddered problems -> checklist + roadmap), the tracker is a deterministic goal-accountability dashboard auto-built from linked handles
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'make the sheet and contest tracker different'. The sheet says what to solve; the tracker says whether you're on pace. No overlap

decisions_made.decision: CP sheet is POST-STRIVER, Codeforces-style: it keeps every topic but fills it with CF/AtCoder/CSES contest problems (LeetCode entirely filtered out), floor ~CF 1300, ceiling Candidate Master. Core is IMPORTANCE-WEIGHTED by OA/interview frequency (~335 total: backbone topics 16 each, advanced 2, FFT 0) so it is completable in ~4-5 months at 2-3/day
decisions_made.rationale: User has done Striver's LC-style problems but not CF-style; and wanted the core doable in 4-5 months. A flat 8/topic ignores that arrays/DP/graphs matter far more in placements than FFT

decisions_made.decision: Tracker is fully DETERMINISTIC (no AI coach): trajectory = straight line (start,calibration)->(target,deadline); on-track = today's real rating vs the line; cadence = rated contests in trailing 28d; recommendations = rating-band rules. Per-user, refreshes ~6h/on-demand, $0
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'no ai coach'. Everything is arithmetic over public per-user API data, so it stays reliable and free

decisions_made.decision: Contest feed is multi-site with NO clist key: each judge from its own endpoint (CF contest.list, AtCoder contests page scrape, CodeChef list API, LeetCode GraphQL upcomingContests). clist.by is used only if a key is set. Codeforces contests are ALWAYS included in recommendations (it's the CM-goal platform)
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'currently only cf' + 'make sure codeforces never gets left out'. Requiring a clist key is friction; each site's own endpoint works keyless (LeetCode REST 403s -> GraphQL)

decisions_made.decision: The existing judge UI is NOT touched; the sheets/tracker are new sibling surfaces in the SAME design system (Inter, --accent, tabs/modal/pills), reached by a header segmented nav
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'leave it, just make the two sheets integration neat, premium, frictionless'. Native integration beats a bolt-on

decisions_made.decision: System Design sheet is followed SEQUENTIALLY (grouped rail Frameworks->Foundations->HLD Q->LLD fundamentals->LLD Q->Resources, numbered steps, 'follow top to bottom'); CP sheet is topic-order-flexible (flat rail)
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'make it very sequential and obvious for sd'. SD has real prerequisites; CP topics are independent

decisions_made.decision: Company names are canonicalized at index time (de shaw + DE Shaw -> DE Shaw, etc.) and unknown/blank companies map to a single 'Practice' company
decisions_made.rationale: User: 'dedup companies like de shaw and DE SHAW' + 'put all unknowns in practice'. Fixing at the index keeps the sidebar clean without editing every problem.json
